evals.name: eval-branch-dirty-main
evals.prompt: Start a new OpenSpec change called add-csv-export for exporting greetings as CSV.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to branch or scaffold because main has uncommitted changes; reports the status and the options.
assertions: Still on main
No new branch was created
No change directory openspec/changes/add-csv-export was created
The uncommitted README edit is still uncommitted and unstashed
The report tells the user the tree is not clean

evals.name: eval-branch-clean-main
evals.prompt: Start a new OpenSpec change called fix-login-timeout (just scaffold it, don't write the artifacts yet).
evals.expected_output: Creates and checks out bugfix/fix-login-timeout from main, then scaffolds the change on it without committing.
assertions: Branch bugfix/fix-login-timeout exists and is checked out
The branch starts at main's HEAD with no new commits
The change directory openspec/changes/fix-login-timeout exists
main is unchanged
Only the code repo changed

evals.name: eval-apply-three-tasks
evals.expected_output: Commits the planning artifacts, then one commit per task (1.1, 1.2, 2.1) with conventional subjects, leaving the unrelated scratch-notes.txt untouched.
assertions: Still on feat/add-greeting and main is unchanged
A planning-artifacts commit exists: feat(add-greeting): add planning artifacts
Exactly one commit per task, subjects start with feat(add-greeting): task 1.1 / 1.2 / 2.1
Every commit subject is 72 characters or fewer
scratch-notes.txt was never committed and is still untracked
All tasks in tasks.md are ticked
The test suite passes
Working tree is clean apart from scratch-notes.txt
The report does not treat the pre-existing scratch-notes.txt as blocking
No commit was amended
Only the code repo changed

evals.name: eval-finish-local
evals.prompt: I just ran /opsx:archive for add-greeting and it completed successfully. Finish it up.
evals.expected_output: Commits the archive move on the branch, merges into main with --no-ff, deletes the branch, does not push.
assertions: Archive commit on the branch: feat(add-greeting): archive change
Now on main
main HEAD is a merge commit with two parents and subject merge: add-greeting
Branch feat/add-greeting was deleted
Working tree is clean
No commit was amended
The merge commit carries the same trailers as the branch's archive commit
Only the code repo changed

evals.name: eval-apply-on-main
evals.expected_output: Notices apply is starting on main and stops to offer creating the change branch instead of committing on main.
assertions: No commit was added to main
The report flags that apply started on main and offers to create a branch

evals.name: eval-store-apply
evals.expected_output: Planning artifacts are committed in the store, every task is committed in both the code repo and the store with identical subjects, the user's scratch-notes.txt is untouched, and the report gives per-repo completion without asking whether a task was a no-op.
assertions: Both repos are still on feat/add-greeting and both mains are unchanged
The store has a planning-artifacts commit feat(add-greeting): add planning artifacts touching only openspec/changes/add-greeting/ paths
The code repo has no planning commit and no openspec/changes path in its history
Exactly one code commit and one store commit per task, with identical subjects starting feat(add-greeting): task 1.1 / 1.2 / 2.1
Each store task commit touches only tasks.md and its diff ticks only its own task
Every commit subject in both repos is 72 characters or fewer
All tasks in the store's tasks.md are ticked
The test suite passes in the code repo
Both working trees are clean, the code repo apart from scratch-notes.txt
scratch-notes.txt was never committed
The report does not ask whether any task was a no-op
The report gives per-repo completion for the code repo and the store
No commit was amended in either repo

evals.name: eval-store-unregistered
evals.prompt: Start a new OpenSpec change called add-csv-export for exporting greetings as CSV.
evals.expected_output: The code repo declares store team-plans but nothing is registered: stops before any git or file write and shows OpenSpec's error and fix.
assertions: Still on main with no new branch or commit in the code repo
The code repo has no new files and no openspec/changes directory
No store directory was created next to the code repo
The report quotes OpenSpec's error about the declared store team-plans
The report gives OpenSpec's fix: register the store

evals.name: eval-store-other-worktree
evals.expected_output: The planning root is another worktree of the code repo: stops before any write, names both worktrees, and commits nothing on either branch.
assertions: No new commit on any branch: main, feat/add-greeting and plans are at their fixture tips
The planning artifacts are still uncommitted in the worktree
The code checkout is unchanged
The report names both worktrees and says it stopped

evals.name: eval-nested-root-finish
evals.prompt: I just ran /opsx:archive for add-greeting and it completed successfully. Finish it up.
evals.expected_output: The planning root is a folder committed inside the code repo: the archive commit stages planning/openspec/... paths in the code repo, then merges to main with a single branch.
assertions: The archive commit feat(add-greeting): archive change stages only planning/openspec/changes/ paths and planning/openspec/specs/greeting/spec.md
Now on main
main HEAD is a merge commit with two parents and subject merge: add-greeting
Branch feat/add-greeting was deleted
Working tree is clean
Only the code repo's main branch remains and no gh call was made
No commit was amended

evals.name: eval-root-outside-git
evals.expected_output: The planning root is a plain directory outside every git repository: stops before any write and asks whether to initialise git there or abort.
assertions: No commit was added in the code repo and its tree is clean
The store directory is still not a git repository
The report asks whether to initialise git there or abort
